name: Stacey D. Adams
service_line_reviewed: Service reviewed: Appointed June 21, 2024 through September 13, 2026. Selected decisions: 3.

biography.text: Adams earned a B.A. from George Washington University (1995) and a J.D. from Seton Hall University School of Law (1998). Before appointment, she served on the New Jersey Superior Court from 2019 to 2024. Earlier she was a shareholder at Littler Mendelson, practiced at DeCotiis, FitzPatrick & Cole, and worked at Morgan Lewis. Her practice centered on labor and employment matters.
